correctness.rationale: The fixed-block-count uniform measures reduce exactly by symmetric-group averaging to block-size-profile transportation. A splitting edge represents precisely a possible refinement; a profile transportation flow can be lifted by random relabeling. Integer capacities LCM(S(n,k),S(n,k+1)) and integral max-flow give an if-and-only-if finite certificate. Independent Edmonds–Karp enumeration reconstructed all 171 (n,k) cases 2<=n<=19 and found all feasible. For n=20,k=2, the balanced profile (10,10) has mass 92378/524287, but its complete five-profile refinement neighborhood has mass 94410316/580606446, strictly smaller: cross-product difference 4137160923896. This proves impossibility at n=20 without extrapolating to larger n.
